data.name: Jumman
data.gender_notes: Jumman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Originates from the Arabic root 'j-m-m' which means 'to be plentiful, to be rich'. The name Jumman signifies a person who is rich in blessings and abundant in resources. The name Jumman carries the meaning “Plentiful, Rich” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jumman usually hope their child will grow to embody plentiful, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a person who is spiritually rich and abundant.
data.etymology: Jumman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Plentiful, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumman total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jumman has cultural significance in the Islamic community, as it represents both wealth and prosperity. among nomadic Bedouin communities, this name was often given to male children, as a sign of hope and anticipation for a rich future. Similarly, in contemporary Muslim societies, parents may choose the name Jumman to express their high hopes and dreams for their child.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jumman is also significant as it is associated with the concept of abundance and divine blessings in Islamic theology. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "God never blesses a people with both wealth and sons, but that He will reward them for both in Paradise" (Tirmidhi). The name Jumman, thus, serves as a reminder for the believer to recognize the blessings of Allah and to strive to be deserving of his endless mercy and generosity.

historical_references.context: Jumman was a brave warrior and a devoted follower of Islam. He participated in several battles alongside the Prophet Muhammad and was known for his courage and strength.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jumman remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
